flops.conventions: torch.utils.flop_counter.FlopCounterMode; dense matmul/conv ops, sparse scatter propagation uncounted (identical accounting across arms); backward profiled through a scalar sum of logits
flops.total_formula: stem_epochs*(stem_train_epoch + val_pass) + n_game_evaluations*val_pass + sum over rungs of [epochs_r*(rung_train_epoch + val_pass) + val_pass + test_pass]; lifting preprocessing excluded, matching #14's per-run accounting
flops.note: post-hoc profile of the campaign run: models rebuilt from the recorded rung masks, counts combined with the recorded stem/game/continuation tallies
